methods.label: Complete the rectangle
methods.explanation:
Complete the polygon to a rectangle by filling in the missing lower-left corner. The right-angle marks show that the completed rectangle has width \(AB=6\) and height \(BC=9\).

The missing rectangle has width \(6-4=2\), since \(CD=4\), and height \(9-5=4\), since \(AF=5\). Subtracting this missing area leaves exactly the polygon:
\[
6\cdot9-2\cdot4=54-8=46.
\]
Therefore, the area is \(46\) square units, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
